reads.note: Qdrant retrieve-as-tool through @qdrant/js-client-rest: GET / (the client's server-version check), then POST /collections/rag_collection/points/search {vector, limit: 4, with_payload: true} (newer clients may use /points/query; both served). LangChain keeps the chunk in payload.content and loader metadata in payload.metadata. The qdrantApi credential (URL) is not in the template: localhost:6333 is a stand-in
